1: // Space Junk Dodger – enhanced graphics
2: // Targets <canvas id="game"> defined elsewhere.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width;
8:   const height = canvas.height;
9: 
10:   // Starfield background
11:   const stars = [];
12:   const starCount = Math.floor((width * height) / 8000);
13:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
14:     stars.push({ x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height, twinkle: Math.random() * 0.5 });
15:   }
16: 
17:   // Audio setup
18:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
19:   function playBeep(freq, duration) {
20:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
21:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
22:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
23:     osc.type = 'sine';
24:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
25:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
26:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
27:     osc.start();
28:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
29:   }
30:   // Ambient low hum
31:   const ambientOsc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
32:   const ambientGain = audioCtx.createGain();
33:   ambientOsc.frequency.value = 30;
34:   ambientGain.gain.value = 0.02;
35:   ambientOsc.connect(ambientGain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
36:   ambientOsc.start();
37: 
38:   // Ship definition
39:   const ship = {
40:     x: width / 2,
41:     y: height - 60,
42:     size: 20,
43:     speed: 4,
44:     dx: 0,
45:     dy: 0,
46:   };
47: 
48:   // Asteroid list
49:   const asteroids = [];
50:   const asteroidSpawnRate = 1000; // ms
51:   const asteroidSpeed = 2;
52:   let lastSpawn = 0;
53:   let gameOver = false;
54: 
55:   // Input handling
56:   const keys = {};
57:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; audioCtx.resume(); });
58:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
59: 
60:   function update(dt) {
61:     if (gameOver) return;
62:     // Move ship based on arrow keys
63:     ship.dx = 0; ship.dy = 0;
64:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.dx = -ship.speed;
65:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.dx = ship.speed;
66:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) ship.dy = -ship.speed;
67:     if (keys['ArrowDown']) ship.dy = ship.speed;
68:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.size, Math.min(width - ship.size, ship.x + ship.dx));
69:     ship.y = Math.max(ship.size, Math.min(height - ship.size, ship.y + ship.dy));
70: 
71:     // Update starfield (slow scroll & twinkle)
72:     const starSpeed = 0.5;
73:     for (const s of stars) {
74:       s.y += starSpeed;
75:       if (s.y > height) s.y -= height;
76:       // twinkle by tiny random offset
77:       s.twinkle = Math.random() * 0.5;
78:     }
79: 
80:     // Spawn asteroids
81:     if (Date.now() - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnRate) {
82:       lastSpawn = Date.now();
83:       const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 20;
84:       const x = radius + Math.random() * (width - 2 * radius);
85:       const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
86:     const rotSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02; // radians per frame
87:       asteroids.push({ x, y: -radius, radius, speed: asteroidSpeed + Math.random(), angle, rotSpeed });
88:       // Play a subtle beep for new asteroid
89:       playBeep(200, 0.05);
90:     }
91: 
92: 
93:     // Update asteroids
94:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
95:       const a = asteroids[i];
96:       a.y += a.speed;
97:       // Remove if off-screen
98:       if (a.y - a.radius > height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
99:     }
100: 
101:     // Collision detection (simple circle vs point approximation)
102:     for (const a of asteroids) {
103:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
104:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
105:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
106:       if (dist < a.radius + ship.size / 2) {
107:         gameOver = true;
108:         // Play collision sound (low pitch)
109:         playBeep(100, 0.3);
110:         break;
111:       }
112:     }
113:   }
114: 
115:   function draw() {
116:     // Clear with slight opacity for motion trails
117:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)';
118:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
119: 
120:     // Draw starfield with twinkle
121:     for (const s of stars) {
122:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.5 + s.twinkle})`;
123:       ctx.fillRect(s.x, s.y, 1, 1);
124:     }
125: 
126:     // Ship with gradient and glow
127:     ctx.shadowColor = '#00ffff';
128:     ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
129:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(ship.x, ship.y - ship.size, ship.x, ship.y + ship.size);
130:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#00ffff');
131:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0066ff');
132:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
133:     const shipGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(ship.x, ship.y - ship.size, ship.x, ship.y + ship.size);
134:     shipGrad.addColorStop(0, '#00ffff');
135:     shipGrad.addColorStop(1, '#0066ff');
136:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGrad;
137:     ctx.beginPath();
138:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y - ship.size);
139:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.size / 2, ship.y + ship.size / 2);
140:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.size / 2, ship.y + ship.size / 2);
141:     ctx.closePath();
142:     ctx.fill();
143: 
144:     // Asteroids with radial gradient and rotation
145:     for (const a of asteroids) {
146:       ctx.save();
147:       ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
148:       ctx.rotate(a.angle);
149:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, a.radius * 0.2, 0, 0, a.radius);
150:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
151:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
152:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
153:       ctx.beginPath();
154:       ctx.arc(0, 0, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
155:       ctx.fill();
156:       ctx.restore();
157:     }
158: 
159:     if (gameOver) {
160:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
161:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
162:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
163:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
164:     }
165:   }
166: 
167:   let lastTime = 0;
168:   function loop(timestamp) {
169:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
170:     lastTime = timestamp;
171:     update(dt);
172:     draw();
173:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
174:   }
175:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
176: })();
